title: Account for debt settlement and restructuring

items.concept: Initial recognition of troubled debt settlement and restructuring (assets, equity, modification); subsequent effective-interest schedule when restructured cash flows exceed carrying amount; maturity payoff
Number-variant twin — debtor settlement by assets and equity; modification when CF < CV (gain) and when CF > CV (new effective rate + schedule + maturity)
Period-end adjusting JEs for effective interest after a CF > CV restructuring; subsequent measurement schedule; January payment entries; maturity settlement
Classify the correct debtor measurement when only terms are modified in a troubled debt restructuring
Distinguish gain on disposal of assets from gain on restructuring of debt in a full asset settlement
